_README: GET INVOLVED PAGE CONTENT — four ways to help, sponsorship
tiers, the money-handling note, and the FAQ list.

ways.title: Four ways to make a difference.

items.title: Financial contributions
items.body: A gift of any size goes directly toward construction and materials — the fastest way to finish classrooms.

items.title: Material donations
items.body: Cement, timber, iron sheets, and classroom supplies are always needed. Tell us what you can provide.

items.title: Partnerships & sponsorships
items.body: Organizations and foundations can partner with us or sponsor a specific need.

items.title: Outreach & visibility
items.body: Share our story and help us reach new supporters — a meaningful contribution that costs nothing.

honest.bodyMid: , and spending on materials and labor is documented in the dated updates and budget on our
honest.bodyPost: . When formal registration is complete, it will be stated here and in the footer of every page.

items.a: Not at this time. Golden Mind Academy is a community-led project and does not yet hold formal charity registration. Donations are gifts toward the construction effort, made through GoFundMe.

items.q: Can I donate materials instead of money?
items.a: Yes — in-kind donations of cement, timber, iron sheets, or classroom supplies can be arranged directly with the project team. Email {{email}} to coordinate.

items.q: How do I know construction is actually happening?
items.a: Dated photo updates are posted on our Progress page, matched against the public roadmap and budget. You can compare what we said with what we built.

items.q: Who can I talk to before giving a larger amount?
items.a: Email {{email}} — we're glad to answer questions, share more documentation, or arrange a call to walk through the budget and site photos.
